mcp.missing: No Python program that embeds the MCP server is an example its CI runs. The CI-run code, tests/test_window_tools.py in libtmux-mcp, is a pytest module that takes its server and session from the mcp_server and mcp_session fixtures, so an excerpt of it does not stand alone. The port must supply a standalone program that its CI runs.

No standalone Ruby program that embeds the MCP server is an example its CI runs. The CI-run program, examples/mcp_protocol.rb, runs inside the repository's Example.run harness, which supplies its server and async scope, so an excerpt of it does not stand alone. The port must supply a standalone program that its CI runs.

No Julia program that starts or calls the MCP server is an example its CI runs. The CI-run Julia test, packages/LibTmuxMCP/test/tools.jl, calls the private LibTmuxMCP._invoke_tool through a helper, and the only CI-run client of the installed launcher is a Python script, packages/LibTmuxMCP/test/product_client.py.
